# awscc_ec2_client_vpn_target_network_association (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::EC2::ClientVpnTargetNetworkAssociation



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_vpn_endpoint_id` (String) The ID of the Client VPN endpoint.

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String) The Availability Zone to associate with the Client VPN endpoint. Used for Transit Gateway-based endpoints in place of SubnetId.
- `availability_zone_id` (String) The ID of the Availability Zone to associate with the Client VPN endpoint. Used for Transit Gateway-based endpoints in place of SubnetId.
- `subnet_id` (String) The ID of the subnet to associate with the Client VPN endpoint. Required for VPC-based endpoints. For Transit Gateway-based endpoints, use AvailabilityZone or AvailabilityZoneId instead.

### Read-Only

- `association_id` (String) The ID of the association between the Client VPN endpoint and the target network.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_client_vpn_target_network_association.example
  identity = {
    client_vpn_endpoint_id = "client_vpn_endpoint_id"
    association_id         = "association_id"
  }
}
```
